name: Unidentified OOM pilot battle droid (Confederate space)
wookieepedia_title: Unidentified OOM pilot battle droid (Confederate space)/Legends
description: An OOM pilot battle droid was stationed on the bridge of General Grievous's Munificent-class star frigate and participated in the ambush on Jedi Master Anakin Skywalker in Confederate space in 22 BBY.
